title: FACET JSON Report v0
description: Machine-readable QC report schema v0 for segfacet. Extended by Stage 2 with a 'features' block.

schema_version.description: Version discriminator for this report schema. Always '0.1' for v0 reports.

config_version.description: The schema_version from the HeuristicConfig that produced this report, for reproducibility.

verdict.description: Overall QC verdict for the case.

reasons.description: Case-level QC findings (not tied to a specific label).

per_label.description: Per-label QC findings, keyed by the string representation of the integer label value.

features.description: Optional Stage 2 geometric/topological feature block. Absent for verdict-only (item 009) reports; present when the pipeline serialises computed features.

findings.description: Optional Stage 4 rule-engine findings (item 035), embedded verbatim from Finding.to_dict(). Absent for reports that did not run the rule engine.

reference_delta.description: Optional Stage 6 delta-to-reference block (item 046): per-label distribution-relative metrics scored against a loaded reference distribution. Absent for reports that did not run the delta-to-reference computation.

image_features.description: Optional Stage 8 image-based feature block (item 061): per-label first-order intensity statistics and optional radiomics extended features. Absent for reports that did not run the intensity extraction.

run_manifest.description: Optional Stage 17 run-manifest provenance block (item 096): segmenter version/SHA, weights hash, seed, dataset id, post-processing toggles, and resolved package versions. Absent for reports that were not given any manifest flags.

reason.description: A single QC finding with a human-readable message, severity, and optional label attribution.

labels.description: Integer label values that contributed to this finding. Empty for case-level findings.

finding.description: A single heuristic rule-engine finding (item 026), embedded verbatim from Finding.to_dict().

rule_id.description: Identifier of the rule that produced this finding (e.g. 'bounds').

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this finding was raised.

labels.description: Offending vertebra integer label values. Empty for a case-level finding.

features.description: Consolidated Stage 2 features for a case: per-label geometry/components/centroid, inter-vertebra relationships, and overlap pairs. Stage 3 adds an optional 'stage3' sub-block.

features_version.description: Version discriminator for the features block, independent of the top-level schema_version. Stage 3 bumps this to '0.2'.

per_label.description: Per-label feature records, keyed by the string representation of the integer label value.

overlaps.description: Voxel-level overlap between label pairs. Empty when no labels overlap.

relationships.description: Inter-vertebra relationships, or null when not computed (e.g. zero labels).

stage3.description: Optional Stage 3 deviation features (spline offset, orientation/curvature, neighbour-consistency). Absent for Stage-2-only reports.

labelFeatures.description: All Stage 2 features for a single integer label.

level_name.description: Anatomical vertebra name (e.g. 'L3'), or the convention's UNKNOWN sentinel for unmapped labels.

bbox.description: Axis-aligned bounding box with named per-axis min/max coordinates.

fragmentation_index.description: Fraction of label voxels in the largest connected component (item 025). Range (0, 1]: 1.0 = intact, <1.0 = fragmented.

stray_component_count.description: Number of components other than the dominant one (item 098): every component but the single largest.

stray_component_sizes.description: Voxel count per stray component -- component_sizes[1:], every component but the dominant one (item 098).

stray_volume_mm3.description: Summed physical volume (mm^3) of the stray components -- every component but the dominant one (item 098).

stray_volume_fraction.description: Fraction of label volume outside the dominant component -- the complement of largest_component_fraction (item 098).

centroid.description: Per-label centre-of-mass in voxel and physical (mm) coordinates (item 013).

centroid_voxel.description: (x, y, z) centre of mass in voxel-index space.

centroid_mm.description: (x, y, z) centre of mass in mm.

overlapPair.description: A single pair of overlapping labels (item 015). Ordered so label_a < label_b.

present_levels.description: Recognised level names in canonical head-to-tail order.

missing_levels.description: Levels absent within the observed [min..max] span, in canonical order.

neighbour_spacings_mm.description: Euclidean distances (mm) between adjacent centroids in canonical order.

out_of_order_labels.description: Level names (in input order) that broke canonical monotonicity.

stage3.description: Stage 3 deviation features (item 022): per-vertebra spline offsets, orientation/curvature, and neighbour-consistency metrics.

per_label_offsets.description: Per-vertebra perpendicular offset from the fitted spline (item 018). Sorted ascending by label.

per_label_orientations.description: Per-vertebra PCA orientation (item 019). Sorted ascending by label.

per_label_neighbourhood.description: Per-vertebra local neighbourhood comparison (item 110): sliding-window statistics and a leave-one-out deviation score/outlier flag for a named feature set. Sorted ascending by label. Unwired: no rule consumes this block yet.

stage3OffsetEntry.description: Per-vertebra perpendicular offset from the fitted spline.

closest_u.description: Spline parameter value (0..1) of the closest point on the curve.

offset_mm.description: Euclidean distance (mm) to the closest spline point.

principal_axis.description: Unit vector (3 floats) of the first principal component in mm-space.

eigenvalue_ratio.description: Ratio of the largest to the second-largest PCA eigenvalue.

tangent_angles_deg.description: Spline tangent angle (degrees) at each centroid's u value, relative to the z-axis.

inter_tangent_angles_deg.description: Angle (degrees) between consecutive tangent vectors. Length is n_centroids - 1.

total_curvature_deg.description: Cobb-like proxy: range (max - min) of tangent angles.

cv_spacing.description: Coefficient of variation of inter-centroid spacings.

spacings_mm.description: Per-adjacent-pair spacings in anatomical order (length n_centroids - 1).

deviations_mm.description: Signed deviation of each spacing from the mean.

outlier_pairs.description: Level-name pairs whose spacing is flagged as an outlier. Each entry is a 2-element list [level_a, level_b].

is_monotonic.description: True iff spline parameter u increases at every consecutive pair.

non_monotonic_pairs.description: Level-name pairs where u did not advance. Each entry is a 2-element list [level_a, level_b].

stage3NeighbourhoodEntry.description: One vertebra's local neighbourhood comparison result (item 110).

window_labels.description: Integer label values of every vertebra in the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

stats.description: Per-feature window statistics, keyed by feature name (e.g. spacing_mm, offset_mm, volume_mm3).

deviation_score.description: max() of the leave-one-out z-scores of the scored feature subset.

is_outlier.description: True when deviation_score exceeds the configured threshold.

stage3NeighbourhoodFeatureStats.description: Window statistics for one named feature at one focal vertebra.

mean.description: Mean of the feature's values over the whole window (including the focal vertebra).

median.description: Median of the feature's values over the whole window (including the focal vertebra).

std.description: Standard deviation of the feature's values over the whole window (including the focal vertebra).

z_score.description: Leave-one-out z-score of the focal vertebra's value against the window's other members only.

referenceDelta.description: Stage 6 delta-to-reference block (item 046): per-label distribution-relative metrics scored against a loaded reference distribution.

reference_delta_version.description: Version discriminator for this block, independent of the report and reference schema versions.

reference_schema_version.description: The schema_version of the reference distribution used to compute this block.

stratum.description: The size stratum requested when computing this block (e.g. 'all').

per_label.description: Per-label delta results, keyed by the string representation of the integer label value.

level_name.description: Anatomical vertebra name looked up in the reference.

available.description: False when the (level_name, stratum) pair is absent from the reference; features/distribution_distance are then empty/null, not an error.

distribution_distance.description: RMS of the defined per-feature robust_z values. Null when unavailable or no feature has a defined robust_z.

features.description: Per-feature deltas, keyed by feature name. Only features the reference tracks and the case carries are present.

imageFeatures.description: Stage 8 image-based feature block (item 061): per-label first-order intensity statistics and optional radiomics extended features, with block-level provenance.

image_features_version.description: Version discriminator for this block, independent of the report schema_version.

available.description: False when intensity was attempted but unavailable (no scan / no backend); per_label is then empty, not an error.

radiomics_available.description: Whether PyRadiomics produced any extended features for this run.

backend.description: Provenance marker for the intensity/radiomics backend used (e.g. 'builtin', 'pyradiomics').

per_label.description: Per-label image feature records, keyed by the string representation of the integer label value. Empty when available is false.

imageLabelFeatures.description: One label's image-based feature record: first-order intensity statistics plus optional radiomics extended features.

extended.description: Flat radiomics feature map (item 060), keyed by feature name. Empty on the builtin (first-order-only) path.

firstOrderIntensity.description: First-order intensity statistics for a single label (item 059).

referenceFeatureDelta.description: One tracked feature's delta-to-reference result for one label.

value.description: The case's value for this (label, feature).

z_score.description: (value - mean) / std. Null when the reference std == 0.

robust_z.description: (value - p50) / (IQR / 1.349). Null when the reference IQR == 0.

percentile_rank.description: 0..100, piecewise-linear interpolation over the stored percentile grid.

out_of_range.description: True when value is below the lower_pct bound or above the upper_pct bound.

runManifest.description: Stage 17 run-manifest provenance block (item 096): caller-supplied segmenter/dataset identity plus auto-resolved package versions.

segmenter_version.description: Caller-supplied segmenter version string, or null when not given.

segmenter_sha.description: Caller-supplied segmenter commit SHA (or similar), or null when not given.

weights_hash.description: Caller-supplied hash of the segmenter's weights, or null when not given.

seed.description: Caller-supplied integer seed, or null when not given.

dataset_id.description: Caller-supplied dataset identifier, or null when not given.

postproc_toggles.description: Caller-supplied free-form JSON-compatible mapping of post-processing toggles, or null when not given.

resolved_versions.description: Auto-populated mapping of package name to its resolved installed version string (null per entry when not discoverable).
